product.description: Indio™ by Monoprice™Boardwalk Semi Hollow Body Electric GuitarWith Maple Body and Neck, Rosewood Fingerboard, and Gig BagThe semi hollow body Boardwalk is the most revered and well‑reviewed Indio™ guitar for a reason ‑ it delivers flawless playability and a perfectly rich, yet useful tone, that is good for Jazz, Blues, Rock, and everything in between. Did we mention that they look amazing, too? Boardwalk guitars embody everything that is good about Indio guitars with superior quality, specs, and style, at a fraction of the cost of other semi hollow body guitars.Classic double‑cutaway semi hollow body designMaple body and neckRosewood fingerboard with block inlaysProprietary ceramic humbucker pickupsBound body and neck TRUE SEMI HOLLOW BODY CONSTRUCTIONUnlike full hollow body guitars, semi hollow body guitars use a center block to mount the pickups. This eliminates the feedback that is typically associated with full hollow body guitars, making semi hollow body guitars the best choice for music that uses overdrive and distortion. Additionally, semi hollow body guitars are lighter and more resonant than their solid body cousins, giving them a mellower tone that is well‑suited to playing both jazz, blues, and rock. Indio™ Boardwalk guitars feature a double‑cutaway body style, a solid maple center block, maple body and neck, and a rosewood fingerboard with block inlays. CLASSIC, HIGH‑END STYLINGBesides practical reasons, like tone and playability, semi hollow body guitars are attractive for their looks and body design. Indio™ Boardwalk guitars deliver classic semi hollow body styling with high‑end touches only found in instruments costing several times more. Featuring a bound body and neck, block inlays on the rosewood fingerboard, and ceramic humbuckers, Indio Boardwalk guitars deliver equally in both tone and looks.   FREE 1 Month Online Guitar Lessons We've partnered with GuitarTricks.com to give you 1 month of free online guitar lessons when you purchase a Monoprice guitar!Guitar Tricks® has taught over 2.5 million people how to play guitar, using a series of fun videos available online or in the Guitar Tricks mobile app. Brand new beginners learn with the step‑by‑step Core Learning System, which teaches you to play with simple songs rather than boring drills and exercises.
